svg.text: The biggest AI training runs grew about two billion times in 14 years
Operations used to train notable AI models, 2012 to 2026. Each labeled line is 100× the one below.

circle.title: NAS with base 8 and shared embeddings, 2016: 1.1 × 10¹⁶ operations
Base LM + kNN LM + Continuous Cache, 2019: 3.0 × 10¹⁹ operations

svg.text: Grok 4 and GPT-6 Astra are Epoch AI estimates; the bar on GPT-6 Astra is its range.
Most labs no longer publish these numbers for their newest models.
